figure_limitations_text:
Camera: Nikon D90 /18mm
Portrait stored axes; EXIF Orientation1

Footprint follows a satellite roof,
while columns, gallery and eave
occupy different depth planes.

Absolute height: uncalibrated.
GHSL8.579m is not a measurement.
limitations: Both facade ends/feet are partly obscured or at different projecting planes. A source roof polygon is not a surveyed wall baseline.
The curved gable coping and eave overhang project substantially toward the camera; using ground-pier H produces highly depth-dependent roof heights.
The source JPEG has trustworthy camera/focal metadata and matching portrait aspect, but no lens distortion calibration or independently verified crop history.
2022 Samsung13mm-equivalent ultra-wide photo is for independent structure/appearance confirmation; its clipped roof and unknown software correction do not supply a second metric height.
The three-bay fractions refer to the same upper-gallery handrail plane and visible post intersections; sensitivity percentiles are not a surveying confidence interval.
The older GHSL100m-cell estimate is not used as a camera or height constraint.
